# **NFS Hot Pursuit 2 (PlayStation 2) file specs** #

*Last time updated: 2026-11-13 15:32:47.691178+00:00*

*Generated by [TailsLab](../README.md) from its parser code.*


# **Info by file extensions** #

The disc keeps every file in **NFSHP2/ZZDATA.BIN**, listed by **NFSHP2/ZDIR.BIN**: 12-byte entries (Black Box hash of the file path, 2048-byte sector, size). The paths are not stored: the executable SLUS_203.62 has them (e.g. "TRACKS\TRACKB%d.LZC").

**TRACKS/TRACKB\<track\>.LZC** track bundle (track = location * 10 + variant, locations 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6): sceneries, meshes, track paths, routes, the ground and wall polygons of the physics and other race data. Opened in the track viewer with its textures and sky. COMP-compressed: One of types:<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TrackBundle](#nfs6ps2trackbundle)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2CarGeometry](#nfs6ps2cargeometry)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2ChunkBundle](#nfs6ps2chunkbundle)<br/>- Bytes

**CARS/\<car\>/GEOMETRY.LZC** car model (COMP-compressed; GEOMETRY.BIN uncompressed): its meshes and collision hull. Textures are in **CARS/TEXTURES.BIN** and **GLOBAL/GLOBALB.LZC**, which has the car types table (wheels, physics values). [Nfs6Ps2CarGeometry](#nfs6ps2cargeometry)

**TRACKS/TEX\<track\>LOCATION.BIN**, **TRACKS/TEX\<track\>TRACK.BIN**, **GLOBAL/\*.BIN** texture packs and other chunk bundles. [Nfs6Ps2ChunkBundle](#nfs6ps2chunkbundle)

**SOUND/JUKEBOXM.JBC** in-game music: the songs of the PC game, stereo PS-ADPCM. [Nfs6Ps2Jukebox](#nfs6ps2jukebox)

Did not find what you need or some given data is wrong? Please submit an
[issue](https://github.com/AndyGura/nfs-resources-converter/issues/new)

### **Nfs6Ps2TrackBundle** ###
#### **Size**: 0..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Track bundle (TRACKS/TRACKB<track>.LZC, uncompressed; TRACKB<track>.BUN): sceneries and meshes of the world of the track, with its race data (track paths, routes, start grid, the ground and wall polygons of the physics, collision volumes of the props, ...). Textures are in TRACKS/TEX<track>LOCATION.BIN and TEX<track>TRACK.BIN. NFS Hot Pursuit 2 (PS2) chunk bundle (*.BUN, *.BIN, uncompressed *.LZC): a sequence of chunks, each having 32-bit id, 32-bit payload length and payload; chunks with the highest bit of id set are containers of other chunks. Mesh packs, texture packs, sceneries, the physics data (track paths and routes, start grid markers, ground polygons, collision volumes, car types) and the lighting materials and paints are decoded, other chunks are kept as raw bytes ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

### **Nfs6Ps2TrackPathRecord** ###
#### **Size**: 40 bytes ####
#### **Description**: A path of the track: the race route or a branch of it (TrackPath, 40 bytes; TrackPathManager::Loader SLUS_203.62 0x207b28) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **path_index** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Index of the path, 0 for the race route |
| 1 | **is_closed** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | 1: the path is a loop (circuit tracks): its spline wraps around |
| 2 | **first_point** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Index of the first point of the path |
| 4 | **end_point** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Index after its last point. The closing point of a loop (a copy of the first one, distance 0) is not part of the path |
| 6 | **num_points** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Amount of points: end_point - first_point |
| 8 | **start_distance** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Distance along the race route at the start of the path (0 for the race route) |
| 12 | **end_distance** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Distance along the race route at the end of the path; of path 0: the length of the race route (TrackPathManager::Init 0x2078e8) |
| 16 | **scale** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Metres of the race route per metre of the path (1 for the race route): a car's route distance = start_distance + distance along the path's spline x scale |
| 20 | **first_position** | 8 | Point in 2D space (x,y), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Position of the first point (= points[first_point]; not read by the physics) |
| 28 | **last_position** | 8 | Point in 2D space (x,y), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Position of the last point (= points[end_point - 1]; not read by the physics) |
| 36 | **spline** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Written by the game: pointer to the QuickSpline (Catmull-Rom) made through the points by TrackPathManager::Init, 0 in the files |

| 0 | **children** | 8 | Array of `4` items<br/>Item size: 2 bytes<br/>Item type: 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Children by quadrant, index (x >= centre) + 2 (y >= centre): node indexes at levels 10..2, square indexes at level 1; 0 for none (TopologyTree::GetSquare 0x152e08) |
### **Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreeSquares** ###
#### **Size**: 8..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Squares of the quad tree over the track (TopologyTree::Loader SLUS_203.62 0x152c10) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x34131 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **elevens** | up to 16-bytes alignment | Bytes | Alignment filler: a run of 0x11 bytes before the actual payload, so that the payload starts at an aligned offset |
| 8 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **squares** | custom_func\*12 | Array of `custom_func` items<br/>Item type: [Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreeSquare](#nfs6ps2topologytreesquare) | Squares |
### **Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreeSquare** ###
#### **Size**: 12 bytes ####
#### **Description**: A 32 m square of the track, a leaf of the quad tree (TopologyTreeSquare): the polygons over it ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **centre** | 8 | Point in 2D space (x,y), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | The square's centre (its corner + 16 m; not read by the game's physics). Square 0 is a dummy at (999999, 999999) |
| 8 | **first_index** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | First of its entries in the polygon indexes chunk 0x34133 |
| 10 | **num_indexes** | 2 | 2-bytes signed integer (little endian) | Amount of its polygon indexes. The squares' ranges are back to back in square order |
### **Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreePolygons** ###
#### **Size**: 8..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Polygons of the ground and the walls for the physics (TopologyTree::Loader SLUS_203.62 0x152c10) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x34132 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **polygons** | (chunk_length/32)\*32 | Array of `chunk_length/32` items<br/>Item type: [Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreePolygon](#nfs6ps2topologytreepolygon) | Polygons |
### **Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreePolygon** ###
#### **Size**: 32 bytes ####
#### **Description**: A polygon of the ground or of a wall for the physics (TopologyTreePolygon, 32 bytes; TrackPolygon::TrackPolygon SLUS_203.62 0x1514a8). Vertex i = (x[i], y[i], z_base + z[i]), the height times 4 with `heights_x4`. Its plane: normal = normalize((v1 - v0) x (v2 - v0)), ground normals point up. A point is over it when (b - a) x (p - a) <= 0 for the edges v0 v1, v1 v2, v3 v0 and, for a quad, v2 v3 (TopologyCoordinate::GetElevation) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **visited** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Written by the game while collecting the polygons of several squares once (BuildTrackPolygons 0x1531f8), 0 in the files |
| 1 | **bbox_select** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Vertex indexes of the bounding box: bits 0-1 the vertex of the smallest x, 2-3 smallest y, 4-5 largest x, 6-7 largest y |
| 2 | **terrain** | 1 | Enum of 256 possible values<br/><details><summary>Value names:</summary>0 (0x0): NONE<br/>1 (0x1): ROAD<br/>2 (0x2): DIRT<br/>3 (0x3): DIRTROAD<br/>4 (0x4): PUDDLE<br/>5 (0x5): DEEP_WATER<br/>6 (0x6): GRASS<br/>7 (0x7): SAND<br/>8 (0x8): SNOW<br/>9 (0x9): DIRT_SHOULDER<br/>10 (0xa): SAND_SHOULDER<br/>11 (0xb): SNOW_SHOULDER<br/>12 (0xc): SIDEWALK<br/>13 (0xd): SNOW_SIDEWALK<br/>14 (0xe): ROCK<br/>15 (0xf): WOOD_WALL<br/>16 (0x10): CACTUS_WALL<br/>17 (0x11): SOLID_WALL<br/>18 (0x12): BOARDWALK<br/>19 (0x13): COBBLESTONE<br/>20 (0x14): MUD_PUDDLE<br/>21 (0x15): ROUGH_ROAD<br/>22 (0x16): GRASS_SHOULDER<br/>23 (0x17): AUTUMN_LEAVES<br/>24 (0x18): AUTUMN_LEAVES_SHOULDER<br/>25 (0x19): MULCH<br/>26 (0x1a): MULCH_SHOULDER<br/>27 (0x1b): ROAD_AUTUMN<br/>28 (0x1c): PLANT<br/>29 (0x1d): POST<br/>30 (0x1e): METAL_GRATE<br/>31 (0x1f): POTHOLE<br/>32 (0x20): CAR</details> | Terrain type: index of the executable's terrain types table 0x318c00 (grip, road noise, skid marks, effects; TrackPolygonCollisionBody::GetTerrainType 0x1d8b28) |
| 3 | **flags** | 1 | 8 flags container<br/><details><summary>flag names (from least to most significant)</summary>0: not_last_ground<br/>1: wall<br/>2: heights_x4<br/>3: ceiling<br/>4: quad</details> | not_last_ground: never kept as GetElevation's last ground polygon; wall (always a quad; yaw control inducing, IsYawControlInducingCollisionBody 0x1d65b0); heights_x4: heights times 4; ceiling: kept after the walls, ConstrainToTopology puts a point under it; quad: 4 vertices, else a triangle (vertex 3 = vertex 2) |
| 4 | **z_base** | 2 | 2-bytes signed integer (little endian) | Height base, m |
| 6 | **slot** | 2 | 2-bytes signed integer (little endian) | Written by the game: slot of its TrackPolygon in the slot pool, -1 none (set to -1 by the loader; leftover values in the files) |
| 8 | **x** | 8 | Array of `4` items<br/>Item size: 2 bytes<br/>Item type: 16-bit real number (little-endian, signed), where last 3 bits is a fractional part | X of the vertices, m (stored in 1/8 m) |
| 16 | **y** | 8 | Array of `4` items<br/>Item size: 2 bytes<br/>Item type: 16-bit real number (little-endian, signed), where last 3 bits is a fractional part | Y of the vertices, m (stored in 1/8 m) |
| 24 | **z** | 8 | Array of `4` items<br/>Item size: 2 bytes<br/>Item type: 16-bit real number (little-endian, signed), where last 8 bits is a fractional part | Heights of the vertices above z_base, m (stored in 1/256 m) |

#### **Description**: Polygon indexes of the quad tree's squares, the squares' ranges back to back; their sum is the amount of indexes or one less (an unused last index: 4-bytes padding) (TopologyTree::Loader SLUS_203.62 0x152c10) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x34133 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **indexes** | (chunk_length/2)\*2 | Array of `chunk_length/2` items<br/>Item size: 2 bytes<br/>Item type: 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Indexes of polygons of chunk 0x34132 |
## **Cars** ##
### **Nfs6Ps2CarGeometry** ###
#### **Size**: 0..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: Car model (CARS/<car>/GEOMETRY.LZC, uncompressed; GEOMETRY.BIN): its meshes and its collision hull. Textures are in CARS/TEXTURES.BIN and GLOBAL/GLOBALB.LZC, wheel positions and physics values in the car types table of GLOBALB. NFS Hot Pursuit 2 (PS2) chunk bundle (*.BUN, *.BIN, uncompressed *.LZC): a sequence of chunks, each having 32-bit id, 32-bit payload length and payload; chunks with the highest bit of id set are containers of other chunks. Mesh packs, texture packs, sceneries, the physics data (track paths and routes, start grid markers, ground polygons, collision volumes, car types) and the lighting materials and paints are decoded, other chunks are kept as raw bytes ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunks** | until the end of file\*8..? | Array of `until the end of file` items<br/>Item size: 8..? bytes<br/>Item type: One of types:<br/>- [ZeroChunk](#zerochunk)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2SolidPack](#nfs6ps2solidpack)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TexturePack](#nfs6ps2texturepack)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2Scenery](#nfs6ps2scenery)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TrackPath](#nfs6ps2trackpath)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TrackPositionMarkers](#nfs6ps2trackpositionmarkers)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TrackRoutes](#nfs6ps2trackroutes)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2Signposts](#nfs6ps2signposts)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreeNodes](#nfs6ps2topologytreenodes)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreeSquares](#nfs6ps2topologytreesquares)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreePolygons](#nfs6ps2topologytreepolygons)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2TopologyTreeIndexes](#nfs6ps2topologytreeindexes)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2CollisionVolumes](#nfs6ps2collisionvolumes)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2CarTypeInfos](#nfs6ps2cartypeinfos)<br/>- [UnknownChunk](#unknownchunk) | Chunks |

#### **Description**: Car types table (GLOBAL/GLOBALB.LZC chunk 0x34600, 64 car types; LoaderCarInfo SLUS_203.62 0x187f98 keeps a pointer to it at 0x330868, the game uses it in place) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **elevens** | up to 16-bytes alignment | Bytes | Alignment filler: a run of 0x11 bytes before the actual payload, so that the payload starts at an aligned offset |
| 8 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **car_types** | custom_func\*1376 | Array of `custom_func` items<br/>Item type: [Nfs6Ps2CarTypeInfo](#nfs6ps2cartypeinfo) | Car types |

| 4 | **load_scale** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Load scale of the lateral force table: table x = load x 0.8 / it (1; 4 on the BUS; Wheel::GetLateralForce 0x1a4d28) |

| 16 | **longitudinal_grip** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Sliding grip (1.01..1.59): sliding force = load x it x terrain's longitudinal grip x catch-up x traction boost (Wheel::GuessGroundForce 0x1a4930) |

| 0 | **mass** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Mass, tonnes (1.5 Corvette, 0.71 Elise, 3.5 bus; RigidBody::CalculateInertiaTensor 0x19cc58, Car::AverageAir 0x135b30, the AI acceleration tables MakeAccelerationTable 0x188df0, the grid order 0x185fe8). A pursuit cop of the tCop subclass built at 0x22db20 gets the mass of its difficulty (table 0x31c5b8) written over it in memory, its inertia tensor scaled the same. PC car.ini Mass (kg) |
| 4 | **dimensions** | 12 | Point in 3D space (x,y,z), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Length, width and height of the body, m (Corvette 4.6, 1.9, 1.2): the inertia tensor of every car type is made of them (the box formula, yaw doubled); not read by the physics. The drive camera frames the look-back target by its height (0x15c880), the cops' formations space their cars by length and width x 1.1 (tCopManager::CalculateCopCarDimensions 0x2276a0). PC car.ini VehicleHeight |
| 16 | **inertia_tensor** | 64 | Array of `16` items<br/>Item size: 4 bytes<br/>Item type: Float number (little-endian) | Inertia tensor, 4x4 row by row, t m^2, in car coordinates (X forward, Y left, Z up), inverted into the body by RigidBody::CalculateInertiaTensor 0x19cc58. Diagonal in every car type: mass / 12 x (width^2 + height^2), mass / 12 x (length^2 + height^2), 2 x mass / 12 x (length^2 + width^2), 1 |
### **Nfs6Ps2CarSuspension** ###
#### **Size**: 32 bytes ####
#### **Description**: Suspension of an axle of a car type (SuspensionInfo, 0x20 bytes; Suspension::ComputeAuxiliaries SLUS_203.62 0x1a5fc0). The force: static load + height x stiffness x (1 + progression x max(height, 0)) + velocity x damping + sway bar stiffness x (height - the other wheel's height), 0 when negative; heights in m, forces in the game's own scale ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **progression** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Spring progression (1..6.5; Suspension::GetProgression 0x1a6558) |
| 4 | **stiffness** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Spring rate (24..100; Suspension::GetStiffness 0x1a6548) |
| 8 | **bump_damping** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Damping while compressing (4.2..6.4; Suspension::GetDamping 0x1a6518) |
| 12 | **rebound_damping** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Damping while extending (4..6; Suspension::GetDamping 0x1a6518) |
| 16 | **sway_bar_stiffness** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Force per metre of height difference to the axle's other wheel (0..85; Suspension::GetSwayBarStiffness 0x1a6508). PC car.ini FrontRollStiffness / RearRollStiffness |
| 20 | **max_height** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Bump stop, m (0.11..0.15): the height is clamped to it, the excess is the overflow (Suspension::IsBottomedOut 0x1a6600: height == it) |
| 24 | **min_height** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Full droop, m (-0.15..-0.1): a ground below it leaves the wheel in the air (Suspension::ComputeAuxiliaries 0x1a5fc0) |
| 28 | **compression_hack** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | The drawn wheel compresses at most this far, m (0.04..0.15): offset = min(0, it - height) (Suspension::GetCompressionHackOffset 0x1a6570, PhysicsCar::UpdateCar 0x139188) |
### **Nfs6Ps2CarDriveTrain** ###
#### **Size**: 64 bytes ####
#### **Description**: Clutch, differentials and gearbox of a car type (DriveTrainInfo, 0x40 bytes; DriveTrain::DriveTrain SLUS_203.62 0x18ae70). The automatic gearbox shifts up at the optimum of CalculateShiftPoints 0x18ac38 x 0.95 (0x3308ac): from (idle + max rpm) / 2 in 50 rpm steps the first rpm where the next gear gives more wheel torque (torque(rpm x next / this) x next / this > torque(rpm)), else max rpm - 200; down at 0.95 (0x3308b0) x the shift up rpm of the gear below, in this gear ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **shift_up_fraction** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Automatic shift up at idle + it x (redline - idle) rpm, only when the global UseOptimalShiftPoints (0x3308b4) is 0: it is 1, the computed optimum is used (CalculateShiftPoints 0x18ac38). 0.8 in every car type. PC car.ini GearShiftPointCoefficient |
| 4 | **unused_4** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | 500 in every car type, not read (no load of these bytes from a car type pointer in SLUS_203.62): no reader of DriveTrainInfo + 4 |
| 8 | **front_final_drive** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Front differential ratio: clutch side angular velocity = wheel angular velocity x it x gear ratio (DriveTrain::GetDifferentialAngularVelocity 0x18b008, ApplyClutchTorque 0x18b6c8) |
| 12 | **rear_final_drive** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Rear differential ratio, as the front one (the same in rear wheel drive cars). PC car.ini FinalGearRatio |
| 16 | **rear_torque_split** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Share of the clutch torque sent to the rear axle: 1 rear wheel drive, 0.6 the four wheel drive cars (911TURBO, DIABLO, MURCIELAGO, LAMBOCOP); rear wheels driven when >= 0.001, front ones when <= 0.999 (DriveTrain::RearWheelDrive 0x18c080, FrontWheelDrive 0x18c0a8). PC car.ini FrontDriveRatio = 1 - it |
| 20 | **clutch_stiffness** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Clutch torque per rad/s of slip while the clutch engages or disengages (0.032..0.055; DriveTrain::GuessClutchTorque 0x18b948) |
| 24 | **num_gears** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Number of forward gears (4 CROWNVIC, 5 or 6): the top gear is num_gears + 1 (DriveTrain::GetTopGear 0x18c0d0; the manual shift up stops there, JoyHandler_ShiftUp 0x13be88). PC car.ini NumberOfGears = it + 2 (reverse and neutral counted) |
| 28 | **clutch_rate** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Speed of the clutch: d(clutch)/dt = it x the clutch state's rate (-3, 0, 1.5, 0 at 0x310050): opens in 1/12 s, closes in 1/6 s (DriveTrain::GetDerivative 0x18b698). 4 in every car type |
| 32 | **gear_ratios** | 32 | Array of `8` items<br/>Item size: 4 bytes<br/>Item type: Float number (little-endian) | Gear ratios: [0] reverse (negative), [1] neutral (0), [2] first .. [num_gears + 1] top gear, 0 after it. PC car.ini GearRatios_0..7 |
### **Nfs6Ps2CarEngine** ###
#### **Size**: 64 bytes ####
#### **Description**: Engine of a car type (EngineInfo, 0x40 bytes; Engine::Engine SLUS_203.62 0x18a7e8). The curves are tables over evenly spaced rpm from idle_rpm to max_rpm, linear between the points (Table::GetValue 0x18f838). Torques in the units of the tonne mass: kN m (the Corvette peaks at 0.62, the PC car.ini's torqueCurve at 549 N m). The HP version of a car differs in its torque curve only; the engine adds 5 % (0x3308a4) for is_hp ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **idle_rpm** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Idle rpm (850..1000): the engine's lower limit (Engine::ComputeAuxiliaries 0x18a988, GetIdleRPM 0x18c2b0). PC car.ini MinRPM |
| 4 | **redline_rpm** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Redline rpm (6000..8500; Engine::GetRedLineRPM 0x18c2a0): the automatic shift points with UseOptimalShiftPoints 0 (CalculateShiftPoints 0x18ac38), the redline mark of the HUD tachometer (0x17f040: floor(it / 500) x 500) and the engine sound's shift pitch (PlayerEngineSound::UpdateToRedLineRPM 0x210880). PC car.ini RedLine |
| 8 | **max_rpm** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Maximum rpm (6600..9300): the upper limit; from max_rpm - 100 the torque is -15 times the curve's (rev limiter; Engine::GetTorque 0x18aa28, GetMaxRPM 0x18c290); the end of the HUD tachometer (0x17f040) and of the engine sound (PlayerEngineSound::Update 0x211390) |
| 12 | **inertia** | 4 | Float number (little-endian) | Moment of inertia of the engine: d(angular velocity)/dt = torque / it (0.00025..0.000565; Engine::GetDerivative 0x18a9d8) |
| 16 | **torque_curve** | 36 | Array of `9` items<br/>Item size: 4 bytes<br/>Item type: Float number (little-endian) | Full throttle torque at 9 rpm points, idle_rpm..max_rpm (Engine::GetTorque 0x18aa28); its highest point x first gear x rear final drive / rear wheel radius / mass orders the grid (0x185fe8). PC car.ini torqueCurve_n (N m, other rpm points) |
| 52 | **friction_curve** | 12 | Array of `3` items<br/>Item size: 4 bytes<br/>Item type: Float number (little-endian) | Engine braking torque at 3 rpm points, idle_rpm..max_rpm: total torque -= it x (1 - throttle) (Engine::GetTotalEngineTorque 0x18aab0) |

### **Nfs6Ps2CollisionVolumes** ###

#### **Description**: Collision volumes: convex polyhedra for V-Clip collision tests, five sub-chunks per polyhedron (LoaderCollisionVolumes SLUS_203.62 0x218e10). A car's GEOMETRY has its hull "<model>_CV"; the track bundles and GLOBAL/INGAMEB the props' (CS_BarrelA_L, CS_SMOKEBOMB...). Without a hull the game takes a box (RectPolyhedron) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x80034020 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **sub_chunks** | until the end of chunk\*8..? | Array of `until the end of chunk` items<br/>Item size: 8..? bytes<br/>Item type: One of types:<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2Polyhedron](#nfs6ps2polyhedron)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2PolyhedronVertices](#nfs6ps2polyhedronvertices)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2PolyhedronEdges](#nfs6ps2polyhedronedges)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2PolyhedronFaces](#nfs6ps2polyhedronfaces)<br/>- [Nfs6Ps2PolyhedronPlanes](#nfs6ps2polyhedronplanes)<br/>- [UnknownChunk](#unknownchunk) | For each polyhedron: the polyhedron, its vertices, edges, faces and Voronoi planes |
### **Nfs6Ps2Polyhedron** ###
#### **Size**: 104..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: A collision polyhedron (PipelinePolyhedron object, 0x60 bytes, used in place; PipelinePolyhedron::MemoryImageLoad). Its features are the next four sub-chunks ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **chunk_id** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x34021 | Chunk ID |
| 4 | **chunk_length** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the chunk payload in bytes (everything after this field) |
| 8 | **elevens** | up to 16-bytes alignment | Bytes | Alignment filler: a run of 0x11 bytes before the actual payload, so that the payload starts at an aligned offset |
| 8 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **list_node** | 8 | Array of `2` items<br/>Item size: 4 bytes<br/>Item type: 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Written by the game: next and previous of the polyhedra list (0x331a18); leftover pointers in the files |
| 16 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **owns_arrays** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | 1 in the files: the arrays are its own (VCPolyhedron::Init 0x1d3148 / 0x1d3200) |
| 20 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **debug_object** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Debug drawing object, 0 in the files |
| 24 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **counts** | 8 | Array of `4` items<br/>Item size: 2 bytes<br/>Item type: 2-bytes signed integer (little endian) | Amounts of vertices, edges, faces and Voronoi planes: the loader sets them from the sub-chunks' sizes (equal in the files) |
| 32 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **maxima** | 8 | Array of `4` items<br/>Item size: 2 bytes<br/>Item type: 2-bytes signed integer (little endian) | Room for vertices, edges, faces and planes: the tool's (200, 400, 100, 2400 for the cars); the loader sets them to the counts |
| 40 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **pointers** | 16 | Array of `4` items<br/>Item size: 4 bytes<br/>Item type: 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Written by the game: the arrays' addresses; leftovers of the tool in the files |
| 56 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **name_hash** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | bStringHash of the name (h = -1, h = h x 33 + byte): FindPipelinePolyhedron 0x219078 finds a car's hull by it ("<model name>_CV", CarCollisionBody::CarCollisionBody 0x1d7e48) |
| 60 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **name** | 32 | UTF-8 string | Name, e.g. "CORVETTE_CV" (36 vertices, 102 edges, 68 triangles); not read by the game |
| 92 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **cog_moved** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | 0 in the files, 1 once moved by a car type's centre of gravity (PipelinePolyhedron::MoveCenterOfGravity 0x2190e0): car types sharing a model share its hull, moved by the first one |
| 96 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **padding** | 8 | Bytes | Leftover bytes |

| 88 | **unk** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Unknown purpose |

#### **Size**: 164 bytes ####
#### **Description**: Texture info: name, size, format and location of its data ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **runtime_pointers** | 8 | Bytes | Written by the game |
| 8 | **name** | 24 | UTF-8 string | Texture name |
| 32 | **name_hash** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Black Box hash of the name (`bin_hash`): texture id used by meshes |
| 36 | **width** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Image width |
| 38 | **height** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Image height |

| 41 | **unk0** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Unknown purpose |
| 42 | **num_palette_entries** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Amount of palette colors |
| 44 | **unk1** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Unknown purpose |
| 46 | **num_blocks** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Size of the full-size image in 256-byte units |
| 48 | **image_placement** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Offset of the image in the data chunk |
| 52 | **palette_placement** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Offset of the palette in the data chunk |
| 56 | **image_size** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Size of the image data, mipmaps included |
| 60 | **palette_size** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Size of the palette |
| 64 | **unk2** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Unknown purpose |
| 68 | **unk3** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Unknown purpose |
| 72 | **shift_width** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Log2 of width |
| 73 | **shift_height** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Log2 of height |
| 74 | **pixel_storage_mode** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | GS pixel storage mode of the texture: 0x13 PSMT8, 0x14 PSMT4 |
| 75 | **palette_storage_mode** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | GS TEX0 CPSM of the palette |
| 76 | **repeat** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Bit 0: repeated in u, bit 1: repeated in v, else clamped (GS CLAMP, 0x108cc0) |
| 77 | **drawn_late** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | 1: drawn after the other textures, sorted (0x10dd58), as windows |
| 78 | **texture_function** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | GS TEX0 TFX: 0 modulate |
| 79 | **no_alpha_test** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Like `vertex_lit_env`: the draw has no alpha test (else texels with texture alpha * vertex alpha / 0x80 below 0x30 are not drawn, alpha test GEQUAL assumed, 0x105ac0) |
| 80 | **unk4** | 4 | Bytes | Unknown purpose |
| 84 | **levels** | 24 | Array of `6` items<br/>Item type: [Nfs6Ps2MipLevel](#nfs6ps2miplevel) | GS upload settings of the full-size image and its mipmaps |
| 108 | **unk5** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Unknown purpose |
| 110 | **num_mipmaps** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Amount of mipmaps |
| 111 | **mag_filter** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | GS TEX1 MMAG: 1 bilinear (SLUS_203.62 0x108cc0 writes the GS settings of the texture) |
| 112 | **min_filter** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | GS TEX1 MMIN |
| 113 | **mipmap_l** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | GS TEX1 L |
| 114 | **mipmap_k** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | GS TEX1 K |
| 116 | **vertex_lit_env** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | 1 in car paints: adds 4 to the VU1 flags of the draw groups (`vu_flags`), the lit vertex colours shade the environment map pass, which in a race is added by the destination alpha: the lighting writes an alpha from the specular of the first light (`Nfs6Ps2LightingParameters`), alpha test always passing (SLUS_203.62 0x10dd58, 0x10b838, 0x105ac0) |
| 117 | **view_matrices** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Which of the 3 view matrix sets of the view the texture is drawn with |
| 118 | **alpha_blend** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | GS ALPHA A, B, C, D of the texture: 0x0a opaque (Cs), 0x44 alpha blended ((Cs - Cd) * As + Cd), 0x48 added by alpha (Cs * As + Cd) |
| 119 | **alpha_fix** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | GS ALPHA FIX |
| 120 | **unk6** | 44 | Bytes | Unknown purpose |

| 84 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **pad0** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x0 | Padding |
| 88 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **bounding_box_max** | 12 | Point in 3D space (x,y,z), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Bounding box of the vertices |

### **Nfs6Ps2MeshDrawGroup** ###
#### **Size**: 64 bytes ####
#### **Description**: A run of VIF packets drawn with one texture: one call of the VU1 microprogram per packet, each packet a set of triangle strips of up to 40 vertices ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **texture_index** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Index of the texture in the textures chunk |
| 4 | **unk0** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Always 0x80008000 |
| 8 | **data_offset** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Offset of the VIF packets in the VIF data (after its alignment filler) |
| 12 | **num_qwords** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the VIF packets in 16-byte units |
| 14 | **vu_flags** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | The VIF ITOP value of the packets, bits of what the VU1 microprogram does (SLUS_203.62 .vutext 0x3d): 0x80 lighting (0x333: the vertex colours become ambient + diffuse + specular of 3 directional lights from the vertex normals, scaled by the vertex colours, see `Nfs6Ps2LightingParameters`), 0x100 environment map pass (0x42b: every triangle drawn again with a sphere map of the reflection vector, added by an alpha from the material), 0x40 an unused third pass, 0x200 clipping (set by the game). 0x4000: the packets have vertex normals. The game removes 0x100 when environment maps are off and 0x80 / 0x100 for a mesh drawn without lights, skips draw groups with 0x400 in the normal draw (0x10dd58) and adds 4 for textures with `vertex_lit_env` set |
| 16 | **bounding_box_min** | 12 | Point in 3D space (x,y,z), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Bounding box of the vertices |
| 28 | **unk1** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Unknown purpose |
| 29 | **num_vertices** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Amount of vertices of all packets |
| 30 | **num_triangles** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Amount of triangles of all packets |
| 31 | **material_index** | 1 | 1-byte unsigned integer | Index of the lighting material in the lighting materials chunk of the mesh (0x3401D), 255: the material "Default" |
| 32 | **bounding_box_max** | 12 | Point in 3D space (x,y,z), where each coordinate is: Float number (little-endian) | Bounding box of the vertices |
| 44 | **vu_flags_2** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | The same as `vu_flags` |
| 48 | **unk3** | 16 | Bytes | Unknown purpose |

| 8 | **elevens** | up to 16-bytes alignment | Bytes | Alignment filler: a run of 0x11 bytes before the actual payload, so that the payload starts at an aligned offset |
| 8 + up to 16-bytes alignment | **data** | custom_func | Bytes | VIF codes and their data |

## **Audio** ##
### **Nfs6Ps2Jukebox** ###
#### **Size**: 37..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: The in-game music of NFS Hot Pursuit 2 (PS2): 23 songs, the licensed ones with and without vocals (style "Rock-4" / "Rock-2") and EA's own ones ("Rock-0", "Techno-0"), the songs of the PC game's `audio/music`. Header, a group of tracks, a 0x60-byte entry per track, then the tracks, each one 0x800-aligned after its 0x30-byte header. Converted to a folder of WAV files named after the tracks ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **interleave** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of a block of one channel in the wave data of the tracks, in 2048-byte sectors: 16 (0x8000 bytes, the interleave which decodes the PC game's songs) |
| 4 | **channels** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Channels of the tracks: 2 |
| 8 | **sampling_rate** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Sampling rate of the tracks: 32000 |
| 12 | **num_groups** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x1 | Amount of track groups: 1 (one more group would make another layout) |
| 16 | **unk0** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | 0x1000: the distance between the end of a track's wave data (with the padding of its last block) and the next track's wave data |
| 20 | **unk1** | 12 | Bytes | Zeros |
| 32 | **group** | 5..? | [Nfs6Ps2JukeboxGroup](#nfs6ps2jukeboxgroup) | The group of the tracks |
| 37..? | **items_descr** | (group/num_tracks)\*13..? | Array of `group/num_tracks` items<br/>Item type: [Nfs6Ps2JukeboxEntry](#nfs6ps2jukeboxentry) | The tracks: offset, length and name of each one |
| 37 + (group/num_tracks)\*13..? | **pre_items_payload** | up to the first track | Bytes | Bytes between the last entry and the first track: leftovers of the tool which wrote the file (0x900..0x17D0) |
| 37 + (group/num_tracks)\*13 + up to the first track..? | **data_bytes** | up to end of block | Bytes | The tracks, at the offsets of `items_descr`. Each one is a [Nfs6Ps2JukeboxTrack](#nfs6ps2jukeboxtrack) |
### **Nfs6Ps2JukeboxGroup** ###
#### **Size**: 5..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: The group of tracks of the jukebox, 0x40 bytes ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **num_tracks** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Amount of tracks: 23 |
| 4 | **name** | 1..? | Null-terminated UTF-8 string. Ends with first occurrence of zero byte | Name of the group: "InGame" |
| 5..? | **name_padding** | 59 - len(name) | Bytes | Rest of the 60-byte name field: 0xCC bytes |
### **Nfs6Ps2JukeboxEntry** ###
#### **Size**: 13..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: A track of the jukebox, 0x60 bytes ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **offset** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Offset of the track (its header) in the file |
| 4 | **header_length** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x30 | Length of the track header: 0x30 |
| 6 | **num_blocks** | 2 | 2-bytes unsigned integer (little endian) | Length of the track (header, wave data and the zeros up to the next track) in 64 KiB, rounded down |
| 8 | **unk0** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (little endian). Always == 0x0 | Always 0 |
| 12 | **name** | 1..? | Null-terminated UTF-8 string. Ends with first occurrence of zero byte | Name of the track: "<artist>-<title>-<album>-<style>", e.g. "Rush-One Little Victory (Inst)-Vapor Trails-Rock-2" |
| 13..? | **name_padding** | 83 - len(name) | Bytes | Rest of the 84-byte name field: leftovers of longer names (e.g. "wav"), 0xCC bytes, a last zero |
### **Nfs6Ps2JukeboxTrack** ###
#### **Size**: 48..? bytes ####
#### **Description**: A song of the jukebox: a stereo PS-ADPCM stream with a "VAGp" header (big endian numbers) ####
| Offset | Name | Size (bytes) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **resource_id** | 4 | UTF-8 string. Always == "VAGp" | Resource ID |
| 4 | **version** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (big endian) | VAG version: 2 |
| 8 | **unk0** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (big endian) | Always 0 |
| 12 | **data_size** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (big endian) | Length of the wave data of both channels in bytes, without the zeros padding the last block of each channel |
| 16 | **sampling_rate** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (big endian) | Sampling rate: 32000 |
| 20 | **unk1** | 16 | Bytes | Zeros |
| 36 | **stereo_id** | 4 | UTF-8 string. Always == "VAGx" | "VAGx" |
| 40 | **unk2** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (big endian) | Always 0 |
| 44 | **channels** | 4 | 4-bytes unsigned integer (big endian) | Channels: 2 |
| 48 | **wave_data** | up to the next track | Bytes | PS-ADPCM frames (16 bytes, 28 samples) of the channels in blocks of `interleave` sectors of the jukebox (0x8000 bytes): a block of the left channel, a block of the right one, and so on. The last round holds the rest of `data_size`, half per channel, each half at the start of its block, padded with zeros. Each channel ends with a silent frame flagged as the end (flags 1) and the terminator frame `00 07 77 77..`; zeros follow up to the next track |
